discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-24, model-driven exploration while building TC-022
note: Reached from the FTR_CREATE Structure screen's 'Conditions' button (ftr-deal-irate.json's conditions button) — before the deal is ever saved, so adding a second interest condition here is part of the same unsaved create, not a later edit. A fresh 1000/22A/100 deal built by fill_term_loan carries two condition rows on the overview grid: 'Nominal interest' (SKOART 1200) and 'Final repayment' (SKOART 1120) — this model only ever addresses the first.

overviewGrid.label: Overview of Conditions ALV grid
overviewGrid.note: Columns: RFHAZU, LOGIC_RKOND, SKOART, XKOART, DGUEL_KP (Eff. From), XDESCR_AMOUNT, XDESCR_DATE. Double-click any cell in a row (drill_into_row) to open that row's Condition Details.

itemEffectiveFrom.label: Item Eff. From
itemEffectiveFrom.note: On the Condition Details screen header. Read-only display of which dated item is currently open — read this back after Copy condition to confirm the new item's date took.

percentageRate.label: Percentage Rate
percentageRate.note: On the Amounts tab of Condition Details. A DIFFERENT field from the deal screen's own nominalInterestRate (PKOND, in ftr-deal-irate.json) — PKOND_ALT is per dated condition item; only the base (first) item happens to also drive PKOND on the Structure screen.

calcFirstDate.label: Calculation date, 1st date
calcFirstDate.note: On the Dates tab. A newly copied condition item's Dates tab is BLANK and must be filled explicitly — it does not inherit the base item's schedule. Left blank, moving off the Dates tab (or validating the Amounts tab) raises hard error 'Enter Due Date' (TM 001).

copyPopupEffectiveFrom.label: Eff. From (Copy condition popup)
copyPopupEffectiveFrom.note: The only field on the popup 'Copy condition' raises. Confirming it creates a brand-new dated item on the SAME condition (same Condition Type/Group) — a rate change mid-term, not a new condition type.

copyCondition.label: Copy condition
copyCondition.note: App toolbar (F5) on Condition Details. Different from 'Create Parallel Condition Group' (NEW_PAR_CND, on the Overview grid's own ALV toolbar) — that button was not used here and was not explored; Copy condition is what produces a later-dated item on the existing condition, which is what a mid-term rate change is.

copyPopupConfirm.label: Copy (popup)
copyPopupConfirm.note: Confirms the Eff. From popup raised by Copy condition. Tooltip reads 'Copy   (Enter)'.
